title: Pad-Steam Treatments of Cotton Fabrics with Vinyl Phosphonate Oligomers and/or N-Methylolacrylamide and Thermal Behavior of the Treated Fabrics
journal: Journal of the Japan Research Association for Textile End-Uses
treatment_method: Base fabric cleaned using 0.2% anionic surfactant, then ethanol/benzene (1:1) Soxhlet extraction and air drying.
treatment_chemistry: none
TGA_instrument: Shimadzu DTG-50 simultaneous TG-DTA; TA-50WS processing
TGA_specimen_preparation: air-dried fabric cut into approximately 2 mm squares; platinum cell with platinum lid
TGA_preconditioning: Heat from room temperature to 100 C at 10 C/min; hold for 20 min; then the stated 10 or 20 C/min ramp to 600 C.
LOI_method: Source reports JIS L7201 and Suga ON-1 oxygen index instrument; identifier retained verbatim without a compliance claim.
TG_locator: Table 2, p 276, 10 C/min: TG Tmax and residue at 600 C; DTA columns excluded.
LOI_locator: Table 1, p 273, exact sample-code LOI. Untreated LOI 18.6 is explicitly stated in the table footnote.
conditions_locator: Section 2.5, p 273: nitrogen 30 mL/min, 100 C prehold for 20 min, then 10 or 20 C/min to 600 C; approximate 7 mg fabric aliquots.
pairing_evidence: Exact untreated/FYR/NMA/F/N sample codes link preparation and LOI Table 1 to both TG Tables 2/3. Two TG ramps are repeat conditions of one prepared material state, not extra samples. Preparative hot-water extraction is not a durability-wash series.
source_location: Original Japanese article pp 272-277; Tables 1-3 and experimental sections 2.1-2.5.
limitations: Original publisher PDF methods and Tables 1-3 visually reviewed. NMA-4 LOI conflicts (21.4 table versus 21.5 prose) and remains held. DTA endotherm/exotherm peaks are not DTG maxima. Authors To/Tf describe main weight-loss boundaries, not T5/T10; only unambiguous TG Tmax/R600 included. Grafting-efficiency formula is not recalculated. Initial thermal prehold is not aging or laundering. Two ramps count as one state.

treatment_method: Base fabric cleaned using 0.2% anionic surfactant, then ethanol/benzene (1:1) Soxhlet extraction and air drying. Pad with aqueous FYR/NMA bath and ammonium persulfate at 10% of monomer weight; approximately 80% pickup. Air dry, steam at 100 C for 10 min, air dry, wash in distilled water at 80 C for 30 min, vacuum dry and store over silica gel.
treatment_chemistry: Fyrol 76 vinyl phosphonate oligomer (FYR) and/or N-methylolacrylamide (NMA), ammonium persulfate initiated
TGA_instrument: Shimadzu DTG-50 simultaneous TG-DTA; TA-50WS processing
TGA_specimen_preparation: air-dried fabric cut into approximately 2 mm squares; platinum cell with platinum lid
TGA_preconditioning: Heat from room temperature to 100 C at 10 C/min; hold for 20 min; then the stated 10 or 20 C/min ramp to 600 C.
LOI_method: Source reports JIS L7201 and Suga ON-1 oxygen index instrument; identifier retained verbatim without a compliance claim.
TG_locator: Table 2, p 276, 10 C/min: TG Tmax and residue at 600 C; DTA columns excluded.
LOI_locator: Table 1, p 273, exact sample-code LOI. Untreated LOI 18.6 is explicitly stated in the table footnote.
conditions_locator: Section 2.5, p 273: nitrogen 30 mL/min, 100 C prehold for 20 min, then 10 or 20 C/min to 600 C; approximate 7 mg fabric aliquots.
pairing_evidence: Exact untreated/FYR/NMA/F/N sample codes link preparation and LOI Table 1 to both TG Tables 2/3. Two TG ramps are repeat conditions of one prepared material state, not extra samples. Preparative hot-water extraction is not a durability-wash series.
source_location: Original Japanese article pp 272-277; Tables 1-3 and experimental sections 2.1-2.5.
limitations: Original publisher PDF methods and Tables 1-3 visually reviewed. NMA-4 LOI conflicts (21.4 table versus 21.5 prose) and remains held. DTA endotherm/exotherm peaks are not DTG maxima. Authors To/Tf describe main weight-loss boundaries, not T5/T10; only unambiguous TG Tmax/R600 included. Grafting-efficiency formula is not recalculated. Initial thermal prehold is not aging or laundering. Two ramps count as one state.
